1.11.50: Added 'Now Playing Bar' position (non-Spicy-Lyrics): renders release date on Spotify's normal now playing widget container (.main-nowPlayingWidget-nowPlaying).
1.11.49: Fixed pill not coming back after closing fullscreen: added fallback to render as floating pill on body when position selector doesn't match.
1.11.48: Added Spicy Lyrics fullscreen position setting (Layout tab > 'Spicy Lyrics Fullscreen Position'): choose to render the release date under the Artist or under the Song Name inside Spicy Lyrics fullscreen mode.
1.11.47: Fixed settings popup going off-screen: added max-height: 90vh with overflow-y: auto to #settingsMenu and max-height: 70vh to tab contents so the menu never exceeds the viewport on small screens.
1.11.46: Reverted overflow: visible CSS on Spicy Lyrics fullscreen .Header/.Metadata/.SongName/.Artists that was clipping media controls off-screen. Fullscreen injection now uses JS-only span append with no CSS layout changes.
1.11.45: Changed fullscreen injection to append release date inside Spicy Lyrics' own .Metadata .Artists span / .SongName span elements so it uses Spicy Lyrics' native styling (fonts, colors, marquee) instead of custom BRD CSS.
1.11.44: Made fullscreen inline injection more robust: added fallback target chain (.Metadata → .SongName → .Artists), unclipped .SongName/.Artists overflow+masks in fullscreen, and ensured .Header/.Metadata overflow is visible so song info isn't cut off when the release date is injected.
1.11.43: Fixed mojibake separator corruption: source default changed from â€¢ to real • bullet, plus legacy localStorage value normalization so no weird characters appear before the date.
1.11.42: Added Spicy Lyrics fullscreen settings toggle (Layout tab > 'Show Release Date in Spicy Lyrics Fullscreen') so you can enable/disable inline release date injection in fullscreen mode.
1.11.41: Fixed mojibake separator (â€¢ → •) causing weird characters before the date, and fixed .Metadata fixed-height clipping that cut off the song title and artist in Spicy Lyrics fullscreen.
1.11.40: Fixed fullscreen inline injection target: release date now appends to .Metadata (below both song name and artist) instead of .Metadata .Artists, avoiding overflow/mask clipping so it works correctly with or without background video.
1.11.39: Release date now renders under the artist name (.Metadata .Artists) inside Spicy Lyrics fullscreen header instead of next to the song title, so it looks built into the lyrics UI.
1.11.38: Fixed fullscreen inline injection: uses spicyPage.classList.contains('Fullscreen') for reliable detection, adds .Metadata .SongName target with retry fallback, and never auto-adds the floating pill in fullscreen mode.
1.11.37: Release date now renders inline inside Spicy Lyrics fullscreen header (next to the song name) instead of a floating pill, so it looks built into the lyrics UI.
1.11.36: Fixed fullscreen listener bug: fullscreenchange event now attaches to document (not window) so the release date pill correctly appears when entering/leaving Spicy Lyrics fullscreen.
1.11.35: Added fullscreen support for Spicy Lyrics: release date now shows as a floating pill overlay when the now-playing sidebar is hidden in fullscreen mode.
1.11.34: Fixed an issue where iTunes/Spotify fallback search logic would grab the release date of popular older songs (like 'In the End') when searching for a newer song (like 'Two Faced') by enforcing strict track name matching in addition to artist matching.
1.11.33: Fixed iTunes/Spotify fallback logic mistakenly prioritizing Kidz Bop or other cover songs that have older release dates by enforcing strict artist name matching.
